translations.web: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
translations.bsb: It is surely not good to punish the innocent or to flog a noble for his honesty.
translations.kjv: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
translations.asv: Also to punish the righteous is not good, Nor to smite the noble for their uprightness.
